data.name: H.O.A Simulator
data.detailed_description:
HOA Sim is a comedic suburban patrol game where you enforce neighborhood rules as an overzealous homeowners association officer. Cruise the streets, inspect properties, issue citations, and chase your daily fine quota while balancing speed, accuracy, reputation, and pure petty power. Spot real violations, avoid false fines, unlock trophies, expand your authority, and prove you are the most feared clipboard in Pinewood.

Full game content includes the complete patrol experience, expanded neighborhoods, a full citation and progression system, unlockable trophies, escalating daily objectives, more violation types, and a complete suburban sandbox built around petty rule enforcement, neighborhood drama, and HOA power trips.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM or better)
